table.note: The empty table never changes; desserts are separate transparent layers.

coordinates: box values are fractions (0–1) of the table image width / height; pixels are on the 1536 × 1024 table image

rendering.zOrder: table, then desserts from the back of the table to the front (by the bottom edge of their box)
rendering.scaleRule: a render keeps its offset from its own serving footprint; on another surface it is scaled to fit that surface (contain, aspect kept, 0.65–1.15)
